body:
### Summary

### Description

When setting `link-mode = "symlink"` in `uv`, running a project depending on Apple's `mlx` library fails with an `ImportError` on macOS. The extension module fails to load `libmlx.dylib` via `@rpath` because symlinking directly from the global cache causes relative paths to resolve against the cache archive rather than the virtual environment layout.

### Environment

- **OS:** macOS (Apple Silicon)
- **Python Version:** 3.13.x (managed by uv)
- **Link Mode:** `symlink`

### Reproduction Steps

```bash
uv init test-mlx && cd test-mlx
echo 'link-mode = "symlink"' >> uv.toml
uv add mlx
uv run python -c "import mlx.core"
```

### Actual Behavior

Fails with an `ImportError` when attempting to load `libmlx.dylib` from incorrect cache paths. 
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
  File "/Users/<username>/AI/appautomaton/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/mlx/__init__.py", line 5, in <module>
    from .checkpoint import CheckpointTensorInfo, inspect_checkpoint, load_checkpoint_tensors
  File "/Users/<username>/AI/appautomaton/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/mlx_spatial/checkpoint.py", line 9, in <module>
    import mlx.core as mx
ImportError: dlopen(/Users/<username>/AI/appautomaton/.venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages/mlx/core.cpython-313-darwin.so, 0x0002): Library not loaded: @rpath/libmlx.dylib
  Referenced from: <31164A29-EA19-340E-9B63-36E81A5C0469> /Users/<username>/.cache/uv/archive-v0/ClgPkDIE-9zsfnlA/mlx/core.cpython-313-darwin.so
  Reason: tried: '/Users/<username>/.cache/uv/archive-v0/ClgPkDIE-9zsfnlA/mlx/lib/libmlx.dylib' (no such file), '/Users/<username>/.cache/uv/archive-v0/ClgPkDIE-9zsfnlA/mlx/lib/libmlx.dylib' (no such file), '/Users/<username>/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13.16-macos-aarch64-none/lib/libmlx.dylib' (no such file), '/Users/<username>/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.13.16-macos-aarch64-none/lib/libmlx.dylib' (no such file)
```

### Expected Behavior

The package should import successfully, as it does with `link-mode = "clone"` or `copy`, requiring `uv` to handle dynamic `@rpath` resolutions appropriately during symlinking.


### Platform

macOS 27.2

### Version

uv 0.13.6 (329bf9448 2026-10-26 aarch64-apple-darwin)

### Python version

Python 3.13.16
title: link-mode = "symlink" breaks mlx library on macOS due to unresolved @rpath/libmlx.dylib
